problems.what: the 'if it is guidance... if it is avoidance...' conditions and 'gently'
problems.replace: help to take action based on the guidance or to come into the present moment and see what you are escaping from
problems.with: help: if it is guidance, to show you the action inside it; if it is avoidance, to bring you gently into the present and show you what you are avoiding

problems.what: 'without trying to disappear inward' and 'what remains'
problems.replace: in order to notice if there is any residual activity
problems.with: in order to notice what remains without trying to disappear inward

problems.what: 'gently' in pressing thumb and forefinger together
problems.replace: press your thumb and forefinger together and then let go
problems.with: press your thumb and forefinger together gently and then let go

problems.what: 'the first second after the rhythm ends' and where to look: fingers, breath, attention, nowhere
problems.replace: notice if there is any residual activity or if it has completely stopped
problems.with: notice the first second after the rhythm ends, and whether there is an echo in the fingers, the breath, the attention, or nowhere at all

problems.what: 'stay upright' lost; 'exactly that level of alertness' became 'a level that is useful to you'
problems.replace: Work with a level of alertness that is useful to you.
problems.with: Stay upright and work from exactly that level of alertness.

problems.what: 'vulnerable child' became 'little vulnerable part'; later lines refer to 'the child'
'in the middle' and 'that's ME!' invented for 'Adult present'; the quotation never closes
problems.replace: And in the middle, the adult – that’s ME!

problems.what: 'to the child' became 'down'; 'I listen again' lost; script has no quotation marks
problems.replace: I send love down and I receive the signal from the child. Then I send love again and receive the signal again.
problems.with: “I send love to the child and I receive the child’s signal. Then I send love again and I listen again.”

problems.what: 'on this website' is not in the published text
'revelation can wait' became 'not allow yourself any revelations'
problems.replace: it's okay to not do any analyzing or allow yourself any revelations
problems.with: analysis can stay off duty and revelation can wait

problems.what: 'the person' invented; published has you return to ordinary awareness and decide whether to re-enter
problems.replace: is when you bring the person back up and send them back down into absorption
problems.with: means returning toward ordinary awareness and then deciding whether to enter absorption again

problems.what: 'name the technique before using it' became telling 'them'
problems.with: (naming the technique before you use it)

problems.what: 'trance has a door in both directions' became 'they can always get out of trance'
problems.replace: it teaches the person that they can always get out of trance
problems.with: it teaches that trance has a door in both directions

problems.what: 'every answer cannot secretly mean deeper' became a point about which questions get that answer
problems.replace: Not all questions should have the answer "deeper."

problems.what: 'return toward ordinary awareness' became 'all the way back up'; 'Feel the room' lost; 'when you're ready' added
problems.replace: When you're ready, open your eyes and bring yourself all the way back up.
problems.with: Open your eyes and return toward ordinary awareness. Feel the room.

problems.what: 'notice what changes as attention gathers' became 'send yourself back down'; 'stop at either point' lost
problems.replace: , or you can close/soften your eyes and send yourself back down into absorption again.
problems.with: . If you choose to continue, close or soften your eyes and notice what changes as attention gathers again. You may stop at either point.
